title: CodeRabbit reviews no IB-Odoo_19 file: path_filters allowlist and dead base branches
objective: Make CodeRabbit review the files it is meant to review in cryptoxdog/IB-Odoo_19. .coderabbit.yaml reviews.path_filters carries four include patterns, which CodeRabbit treats as an allowlist; those four files are also excluded by !tests/**, so every PR file is skipped. Rewrite path_filters as exclusions only, keep the intended exclusions narrow, and point auto_review.base_branches at the real promotion branch Production.
success_criteria: .coderabbit.yaml reviews.path_filters contains no pattern without a leading ! (V1)

a Python file, a docs/*.md file, a tests/test_*.py file and a security/ir.model.access.csv are not matched by any exclusion, while plasticos_partner_import/erp_extracted_data/bulk/*.csv and odoo-enterprise/** are (V2)
the file parses as YAML and validates against https://coderabbit.ai/integrations/schema.v2.json (V3)
on the published PR, CodeRabbit no longer reports 'Review skipped due to path filters' for .coderabbit.yaml (V5)

out: every other .coderabbit.yaml key (profile, tools, path_instructions, labeling)
Quantum-L9/coderabbit central config and the Quantum-L9/.github seeder renderer: separate repository, handed to its own session
docker-compose.yml / .env.example L9_SIGNING_ALGORITHM: deferred by the operator

todos.task: Replace the reviews.path_filters list with exclusions only: **/.venv/**, **/.mypy_cache/**, **/.pytest_cache/**, **/.ruff_cache/**, **/__pycache__/**, **/*.pyc, **/node_modules/**, odoo-enterprise/**, **/*.zip, plasticos_partner_import/erp_extracted_data/bulk/**, plasticos_partner_import/erp_extracted_data/meta/**, plasticos_partner_import/erp_extracted_data/diagnostics/**, docs/**/*.csv, ERP.WksDetail.Test.csv, each with a leading !. Drop the four include lines, the three test exclusions and the blanket !*.csv. Keep a comment stating that a pattern without ! turns the list into an allowlist.
todos.shared_root_cause: include patterns used as exceptions turned the filter list into an empty allowlist

todos.task: Set reviews.auto_review.base_branches to [Production] (Staging is the default branch and is reviewed without being listed).
todos.shared_root_cause: configuration copied from a template with main/master/develop branch names

milestones.outcome: CodeRabbit sees every reviewable file on Staging and Production PRs
milestones.unlocks: summaries and walkthroughs on every PR now; line review once seats are assigned

checkpoints.evidence_required: V2 prints the expected reviewed/excluded verdict for every sample path
checkpoints.no_go_action: stop; adjust the exclusion patterns before publishing

doc_root_surface_impact.reason: reviewer-bot configuration only; no documented repository contract names CodeRabbit filters

disconfirming_questions: Does CodeRabbit match a bare pattern such as *.zip at every depth? (use **/ prefixes so depth does not matter)
Do the projection .sql scripts live under the excluded bulk/meta/diagnostics folders? (no: they sit in erp_extracted_data/ itself)
Is Staging reviewed without being listed in base_branches? (CodeRabbit reviews the default branch; Staging is the default)
assumed_false_ifs: If CodeRabbit glob matching differed from fnmatch-style ** semantics, V2 would not predict its verdict; V5 on the live PR is the final witness
stress_test.blast_radius: CodeRabbit review scope on cryptoxdog/IB-Odoo_19 only; no runtime, CI gate or Odoo code changes

deletions_or_consolidations: removes four include lines, three test exclusions and the blanket CSV exclusion

risks.risk: large data CSVs outside the listed folders get reviewed and spend review budget
risks.mitigation: remaining non-security CSVs are small Odoo seed data and business-rule tables that are legitimately reviewable

risks.risk: the organization has no free CodeRabbit seats, so only a summary is produced
risks.mitigation: reported to the operator; out of scope for configuration

risks.risk: CodeRabbit glob semantics may differ from Python full_match for edge patterns
risks.mitigation: every pattern uses an explicit **/ or a fixed repo-relative prefix; V5 reads the live PR verdict

final_validation.command: python3 -c "import yaml;c=yaml.safe_load(open('.coderabbit.yaml'));pf=c['reviews']['path_filters'];assert pf and all(p.startswith('!') for p in pf),pf;assert c['reviews']['auto_review']['base_branches']==['Production']"

python3 -c "import yaml,pathlib;pf=[x[1:] for x in yaml.safe_load(open('.coderabbit.yaml'))['reviews']['path_filters']];ex=lambda s:any(pathlib.PurePath(s).full_match(g) for g in pf);keep=['plasticos_gate/services/gate_config.py','docs/GATE_ODOO_WIRING.md','tests/test_odoo19_compat.py','plasticos_gate/security/ir.model.access.csv','plasticos_partner_import/erp_extracted_data/10_counterparty.sql'];drop=['plasticos_partner_import/erp_extracted_data/bulk/x.csv','odoo-enterprise/a/b.py','x/__pycache__/y.pyc','ERP.WksDetail.Test.csv'];assert not any(map(ex,keep)),[k for k in keep if ex(k)];assert all(map(ex,drop)),[k for k in drop if not ex(k)]"
